# src.store.BackupCheck
# kaynak: src/store/backup.py
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BackupCheck:
    name: str
    ok: bool
    format: Optional[int]
    scope: Optional[str]
    manifest: Mapping[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    members: int = 0
    bytes: int = 0
    problems: Tuple[str, ...] = ()
